# Registre Parcellaire Graphique; Crop Fields France

France field boundaries (2017, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Anstitut National de l'Information Géographique et Forestière. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/fr/latest/fr.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/fr/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2154; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: group_code, collection, id, geometry, crop:code, hcat:code, hcat:name_en, hcat:name, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/fr/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/fr/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/fr/collection.json
